projectDescription: SIGAS (Sistema de Gestión de Atención de Salud) is a web-based health center management platform that enables administrators to schedule patient appointments, manage clinical boxes, track mammography referrals, and audit all system activity.
keyFeatures: Daily box occupancy dashboard with color-coded appointment types
Patient appointment scheduling with automatic box assignment
Overbooking (sobrecupo) support for high-demand time slots
Direct box/room reservation for internal use
Mammography referral tracking with multi-stage status workflow
Weekly and monthly clinical box schedule views
Patient record management with RUT-based search
Specialist management with care type assignments
Multi-administrator account management with role-based access
Full administrator audit trail for all system actions
publicApiSurface: GET /modulos/api_citas.php?accion=box_rango&box_id={id}&fecha_inicio={date}&fecha_fin={date} — retrieve appointments by box and date range
POST /modulos/api_citas.php?accion=guardar_cita — create a patient appointment or mammography referral
POST /modulos/api_citas.php?accion=guardar_reserva_box — create an internal box reservation
POST /modulos/api_citas.php?accion=eliminar — delete an appointment (requires admin password)
GET /modulos/ajax_obtener_disponibilidad.php — get available time slots for a care type and date
GET /modulos/ajax_obtener_disponibilidad_box.php — get available slots for box scheduling
POST /modulos/api_administradores.php?accion=guardar — create or edit an administrator
GET /modulos/api_especialistas.php?accion=atenciones&especialista_id={id} — get care types assigned to a specialist
POST /modulos/api_especialistas.php?accion=guardar — create or edit a specialist
